import sys

from telos import aos_manager

aos_manager.log_structured_action(tick=TICK_TO_LOG, type="create", target="Mail to Progressor I", metadata={"mail_id": "mail_11"})
aos_manager.log_structured_action(tick=TICK_TO_LOG, type="submit", target="Log Tick 187 Actions", metadata={"status": "failed", "reason": "Command not recognized"})
